verdict.rationale:
Meilisearch is a single self-contained binary with no external dependencies, installable via a single curl command and runnable on bare metal, containers, or CI machines with no GUI (docs-11, docs-12, docs-18, docs-19). Runtime probe evidence confirms a keyless local instance boots headlessly and performs a full index+search roundtrip via HTTP API with zero configuration (probe-rt-1, probe-rt-2), and docs-36 covers production/automation deployment via systemd and master-key auth, all fitting CI/headless automation workflows.
missing for 10: explicit first-party CI pipeline examples (e.g., GitHub Actions snippets) or a documented headless test/automation guide.
